item.title: Cotton Tassels and Tie Cords
item.description:
Cotton Tassels and Tie Cords (item 2601052) is developed for apparel brands, importers and trim wholesalers. As a one-stop garment accessories platform we confirm size, color, finish and packing against an approved sample. Reference material: Cotton, wood bead, shell. Final composition, plating, dimension and inspection are locked after sampling. Typical use: ready-to-wear, knitwear, bridal, scarves and private-label programs.

For a quote send item number, quantity, color or plating, end use and destination. Sampling is handled in Guangzhou. Browse Tassels & Cords or request a written offer.
